name: Starstruck

features.name: Multiplying Wilds
features.description: x2, x3 or x5 stacked wilds that multiply together.

features.name: Hot Zone
features.description: A Starstruck symbol on reel 2 triggers the feature.

review:
Starstruck is a compact 3x3 classic slot with five-row stacked wilds carrying x2, x3 or x5 multipliers. The x5 wilds only appear on the middle reel, and several wilds in the same line multiply together.

Landing the Starstruck symbol in the hot zone on reel 2 triggers the feature. Nolimit rates it Medium volatility, with a 1,635x cap and a 37% hit rate. A simple, frequent-win game.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
